Maps each NEUTRAL feature to this wrapper's own assign, kind, and — for enums — the option set THIS component actually declares. Two consumers: (1) `mix pa.fidelity.dump popconfirm` drives rendering generically from it; (2) core's capability.mjs diffs it against the oracle feature contract. NOTE: keen's popconfirm/1 wraps the trigger slot in an anchor <div data-pa-popconfirm-trigger> (it can't attach the trigger data-attr to arbitrary slot content) and carries data-placement + data-pa-popconfirm-close JS-contract attrs on the overlay/buttons — all keen-specific interactivity scaffolding the svelte wrapper expresses via callback props instead. The fidelity dump seeds an empty inner_block slot, so the trigger wrapper renders empty; the overlay subtree is the comparable part. keen's icon_variant additionally accepts "default" (bare __icon) — an extra capability beyond the oracle enum, not declared here.
